report_name: GAO: Poor Fraud Management Puts DoD IT Programs at Cyber Risk

identities.name: U.S. Department of Defense
identities.description: The U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) was identified by a U.S. Government Accountability Office (GAO) report as having systemic failures in managing fraud risks for its major IT programs. These failures have led to nearly $11 billion in confirmed fraud losses since 2017 and have increased the cybersecurity risk to critical defense systems due to a lack of risk assessments and staff training.
